DATED: 12/04/2023  IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/SPECIAL CIVIL APPLICATION NO. 6172 of 2023 =============================================
 KARHSANBHAI BHIKHABHAI PARMAR  Versus  STATE OF GUJARAT =============================================
Appearance:
MR K I KAZI(5030) for the Petitioner(s) No. 1 MR SANJAY UDHWANI, AGP for the Respondent(s) No. 1 for the Respondent(s) No. 2,3,4,5 =============================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE THE ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE MR. JUSTICE  A.J.DESAI  and  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE BIREN VAISHNAV

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE MR. JUSTICE A.J.DESAI)
1.

By way of the present petition under Articles 14, 19, 21 and 226 of the Constitution of India,
following prayers have been made :
"(a) Issue a writ of mandamus or a writ in the nature of mandamus or any other appropriate writ order or direction, directing the respondents to consider an application preferred by the petitioner on dated 30.06.2022 Ann.'B' and also directing the respondents to carry out an activity to return land of the petitioner i.e.
Revenue Survey Number 100 paiki 19 Hector - Are - Sq.mt. 0- 33-50 of mouje Vajdi (Vad) Village of Taluka Lodhika, District Rajkot, in interest of justice.
Karhsanbhai Bhikhabhai Parmar vs State Of Gujarat on 12 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81461768/
1 (b) Grant any other relief/s as may deem fit in the interest of justice."
C

entities.text: Karhsanbhai Bhikhabhai Parmar vs State Of Gujarat
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: . It is the case of the petitioner that though the land was acquired by the respondent authority, no compensation has been paid and the land is not being used and therefore, an application was made to Land Acquisition Officer i.e. District Collector, Rajkot on 30.06.2022, which has not been dealt with by the District Collector.

3. In view of the above, we dispose of this petition with the following directions :
The District Collector, Rajkot, is hereby directed to decide the application dated 30.06.2022 as early as possible, in accordance with law and after examining all the documents.
It is made clear that we have not gone into the merits of the case.

(A.J.DESAI, ACJ) (BIREN VAISHNAV, J) GAURAV J THAKER Karhsanbhai Bhikhabhai Parmar vs State Of Gujarat on 12 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81461768/
